description: M0 giant-file split candidate inventory with current-checkout line counts. The required starting set (from repo-shape.md §9.1) is included plus additional candidates discovered during M0 scan. M4 consumes this inventory to guide splitting. This is a documentation artifact — no code splitting occurs in M0.
measurement_method: wc -l (Unix line count, includes blank lines and comments)

required_starting_set.description: These five files are the canonical starting set from repo-shape.md §9.1. M4 must split these first.

candidates.notes: Public SDK implementation — DTOs, exception taxonomy, serialization helpers, discovery/invoke/generate facades. The largest public-surface file. Likely split targets: exceptions to own module, DTOs to separate module, helpers to shared library.
Subcommand router — session gate, command dispatch, brief/video fall-through to video_editing.hype. Likely split targets: subcommand handlers to separate modules, routing logic to dedicated module.

Timeline CLI — the single largest file in the repository. Enormous scope covering CRUD, edits (audio, clip, effect, pool, track, transition), erasure, integrity, migration, projection, undo, observability. High-priority split target. Likely split targets: one module per edit type, separate CRUD module, separate migration module.

Pack installation logic. Handles git pack install, dependency resolution, and local pack management. Likely split targets: git operations to separate module, dependency resolution to separate module, local pack management to separate module.
Pack CLI — command routing and UX for pack operations. Likely split targets: subcommand handlers to separate modules.

additional_candidates.description: Files exceeding the 1,000-line giant threshold discovered during M0 scan. These are secondary candidates for M4 after the starting set is addressed.

candidates.notes: Task gate logic — gate checks, attestation, repeat, cursor. Core task kernel component. Likely split targets: gate check implementations to separate modules, attestation to dedicated module.
Operator view rendering for task state visualization. Likely split targets: view templates to separate modules, rendering logic to dedicated module.
Session CLI — session management commands. Likely split targets: subcommand handlers to separate modules.
Timeline event schema type definitions. Large type hierarchy. Likely split targets: type categories to separate modules.
Core pack module — pack manifest loading, element kind registry, pack manifest path resolution. Likely split targets: manifest parsing to separate module, registry to separate module.
Executor runner — executor invocation and lifecycle. Likely split targets: lifecycle phases to separate modules.
Banodoco schema definitions for timeline. Likely split targets: schema sections to separate modules.
Timeline projection — computing effective timeline state from event log. Likely split targets: projection strategies to separate modules.
Pack validation logic. Likely split targets: validation rules to separate modules by pack component type.
Project CLI — project management commands. Likely split targets: subcommand handlers to separate modules.

pack_internal_giants.description: Large run.py files inside pack executor/orchestrator directories. These are capability implementations, not framework code. M4 may address them separately from framework splits.

candidates.notes: Hype orchestrator run script — the largest pack-internal file.
Sprite sheet executor run script.
Dataset build orchestrator run script.
Cut executor run script.
Generate video executor run script.

below_threshold_notable.description: Files near but below the 1,000-line threshold that may become candidates in future milestones.

candidates.notes: Task plan logic — close to threshold.
Task event definitions — close to threshold.
Timeline inverse operations — close to threshold.
Executor CLI — close to threshold.

split_priority_guidance.description: Recommended M4 split order based on file size and architectural impact.
